anchor_evidence_contract.binding_rule: exact_subject_match or explicitly equivalent scope binding to resolved Current Subject

anchor_target_contract.causal_claim_rule: The anchor records the source-authorized measurement relationship only; causal efficacy is not upgraded beyond the source/protocol authority.
anchor_target_contract.directionality_rule: Direction must be declared by each admitted metric/protocol family; no generic higher-is-stronger rule is inferred across metrics.
anchor_target_contract.semantic_definition: A numeric change in a declared exfoliation-response measurement observed for the exact final-product formulation under a declared protocol, relative to a declared baseline or comparator, at a declared timepoint.

calibration_entry_gate.anchor_gate: At least one comparable numeric anchor observation is required for each of the three frozen structurally eligible products, all within one comparability family.

measurement_shaped_precedents.semantic_boundary: measurement-shaped hydration change; not reused as exfoliation anchor
measurement-shaped TEWL change; not reused as exfoliation anchor

multi_active_contract.aggregation_rule: No additive/mean/max attribution to active identities. The observed anchor belongs to the final product; predictor lineages remain separate.
multi_active_contract.concentration_linkage_rule: Concentration remains attached only to its matching contains_active parent lineage and does not become target ground truth.

next_stage_recommendation.scope: Search the exact three-product frozen 8K cohort for product-specific primary numeric/ordinal outcome evidence that satisfies the 8L comparability and provenance contract.
next_stage_recommendation.stage: Exfoliation Load Targeted Numeric Anchor Evidence Research Wave 1
next_stage_recommendation.why: The Product Fact architecture already supports measurement-shaped facts, but no exfoliation anchor evidence or source-driven metric/unit vocabulary exists yet.
next_stage_recommendation.will_prove: Whether a comparable source-native anchor family actually exists for the frozen cohort and what exact Registry metric/unit vocabulary can be justified.

numeric_comparability_contract.cross_active_rule: No ingredient potency equivalence is required when the anchor measures the final-product outcome under one comparable protocol family; ingredient-level attribution remains unauthorized.
numeric_comparability_contract.cross_product_rule: Each anchor must bind to a resolved Current Product Fact Subject for the exact/equivalent final formulation and compatible market/formulation scope.
numeric_comparability_contract.cross_protocol_rule: Incompatible protocol families remain separate anchor strata and cannot be normalized into one calibration target without validated transformation authority.
numeric_comparability_contract.same_family_requirement: Numeric anchors may be pooled for calibration only when all comparability fields are identical or an explicit pre-existing equivalence contract authorizes the difference.
numeric_comparability_contract.unit_conversion_rule: No unit conversion unless a governed exact conversion applies to the same metric; no cross-metric normalization.

prospective_registry_fact_family.missing_semantics: missing remains unknown; no zero imputation
prospective_registry_fact_family.positive_evidence_requirement: product-specific measurement bound to the exact/equivalent final-product Subject
prospective_registry_fact_family.publication_blocker: No authoritative exfoliation-response metric/unit vocabulary has been acquired under V2.1-8L; inventing units or a universal score is forbidden.
prospective_registry_fact_family.semantic_definition: Measurement-shaped final-product exfoliation-response change under a declared metric/protocol, baseline/comparator, exposure, timepoint, and anatomical-site context.
prospective_registry_fact_family.zero_and_negative_values: If the admitted metric permits zero/negative change, those are measurement values, not absence/missing semantics.

targeted_research_contract.registry_materialization_rule: Even if evidence is found, Current materialization requires a separately approved Registry definition/extension before Product Fact ingestion.
targeted_research_contract.search_objective: Find product-specific primary measurement/outcome evidence satisfying the anchor contract without using predictor/context surrogates.
targeted_research_contract.stop_rule: Do not expand to generic catalog evidence research or invent a metric/unit. Freeze the exact source/protocol gap.
